training.start: Continue each matched arm's last checkpoint at epoch 8, including Adam state and TRAIN shuffle RNG

stopping: Use only validation accuracy for stopping. Earliest eligible common epoch with all 12 runs passing all three thresholds; otherwise continue every arm to the next common checkpoint or cap. At the cap identify runs that did not meet the plateau rule. Record tail validation CE for interpretation.
selection: Highest original VAL correct count across the actual trajectory including archived epochs 1-8, then lowest VAL CE, then earliest epoch
interpretation: Stability of recent validation accuracy within stated tolerances under this optimizer and budget. Test accuracy and training loss do not decide stopping or checkpoint selection.
